Summary / CRM notes:
- Account: Rosebank Signalworks (mid-market SaaS, product analytics). Product team building in-app support + document search layer.

- POC scope agreed: 4-week Dedicated trial (single GPU pool) focusing on semantics (embeddings + rerank) and chat assistant. Primary goals: 95p latency <= 120ms on short queries, support 250 concurrent sessions (burst to 400), embedding recall improvement over current vector DB baseline by +6-12% on evals.
- Security: Must support SSO/SAML, KMS-managed keys, and audit logs forwarded to customer Splunk. Data residency: US-only for PII.
- Pricing sensitivity: mid-market budget; flagged by finance - wants 3 pricing scenarios (reserved monthly, committed annual, and hybrid with burst). Target ARR band ~$85k-180k.
- POC technical plan (from call):
  * Week 0: network peering + IAM/KMS set up; exchange minimal infra details; SE (Liam) to provide dedicated sizing template.
  * Week 1: Deploy Dedicated small pool with model v1 (gpt-style open-v variant) via Redwood private tenant, run smoke tests.
  * Week 2: Canary rollout plan: route 5% live traffic to Dedicated variant for 48h, monitor latency, error rate, and hallucination/regression metrics (eval prompt set). If pass -> increase to 25% for 48h, then full cutover. Canary rollback automated if any of: 95p latency > 150ms, token error rate > 0.8%, or quality drop (eval score delta <= -3%).
  * Fallback routing: primary route -> Dedicated model-v1; fallback policy -> hosted_api model-quantized-v2 (cheaper, lower latency); region failover -> eu-west-1 / us-east-1 pair for infra outages. Routing rules to include model variant mapping and automatic degrade to 'small-quant' when throughput saturates.
  * Monitoring: integrate Redwood Console with customer SLOs; set alerts for cost per 1M tokens and latency band.
- SE notes: need sample eval set (500 prompts) from product, plus a labeled reranking set (~2k pairs). Ask: provide baseline outputs from current provider for comparison.
